question: For each Form 1099-B or substitute statement you recorded a sale from, is box 7 ("If checked, loss is not allowed based on amount in 1d") checked for any sale on it?

cases.note: covered-st box 7 yes beside a gain

schedule-d.line-16.blocked_explain: Schedule D line 16 has no value yet. It is waiting for line 7 or line 15. It is also blocked while a recorded Form 1099-B statement has no answer about box 7. It is blocked when box 7 is checked and a sale on that statement is at a loss: a loss based on the box 1d amount is not allowed, and this return does not compute it.
